name: Global Sources B2B
description: High-end verified suppliers, trade shows, consumer electronics, and smart hardware sourcing.
fullDescription: Global Sources connects international buyers with premium, verified Asian manufacturers through its omnichannel B2B platform and world-renowned Hong Kong trade shows. It specializes in consumer electronics, mobile accessories, lifestyle goods, and smart hardware.
features: Curated network of verified suppliers and export-oriented OEM/ODM factories
Flagship Hong Kong trade show match-making and VIP buyer summits
In-depth industry research and product trend forecasting whitepapers
Sample order support with certified international safety compliance testing
Direct communication channel with engineering teams for custom development
